reasoning: ModelExpress (NVIDIA Dynamo ModelExpress) is a Rust workspace that contains both a gRPC metadata/model-cache service (modelexpress_server, plus client and common crates) and a Kubernetes operator (operator, operator-openshift). The midstream RHOAI fork adds a kube-rs controller that owns the ModelExpressServer CRD (modelexpress.opendatahub.io/v1alpha1). It reconciles that CR into a Deployment, Service, PVC, RBAC and NetworkPolicy. The repo also ships kustomize manifests under config/manifests (crd, manager, rbac, samples) in the usual operator layout. Konflux builds two images from this repo, odh-modelexpress-operator (Dockerfile.konflux.operator, modelexpress-operator-openshift binary) and odh-modelexpress (Dockerfile.konflux, modelexpress-server binary), as the .tekton pipelines show. I chose 'operator' because the platform's entry point is the operator, which deploys and manages the server workload. The modelexpress-server it manages is a service component in the same repo, and the client crate acts as a library used by inference runtimes.
